title: Asset and Vulnerability Management

header.html: 4.2 Explain the security implications of proper hardware, software, and data asset management; 4.3 Given a scenario, perform tasks associated with vulnerability management
the official CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 V8 exam objectives, document version 2.0

html:
1Asset management

You cannot protect what you do not know you have. Asset management tracks hardware, software and data through their whole life.

Stage What happens Security point
Planning / scoping Decide what is needed and the requirements Include security requirements early
Acquisition / procurement Buy from trusted suppliers Check supply chain risk
Assignment / accounting Record an owner and a record for each asset Accountability, inventory
Monitoring / asset tracking Track location, state and use Find unmanaged and rogue assets
Disposal / decommissioning Retire safely Sanitize data, remove from inventory, certify destruction

Exam tip

. An accurate inventory is the first step of security. Disposal needs data sanitization (wiping, destruction) and removal from the inventory. Ownership gives accountability.

2Vulnerability management: identification

Method Meaning
Scanning Automated vulnerability scanners check systems for known flaws (credentialed scans log in and see more; non-credentialed scans see what an outsider sees)
IPAM Internet Protocol Address Management: tracks IP space and finds unknown devices
CSPM Cloud security posture management: checks cloud configuration for risks
Source code review Examine code (manually or with static analysis) for flaws

3Prioritization, remediation, verification and reporting

Step Meaning
Prioritization Severity assessment (CVSS, exploitability, asset value, exposure) and penetration test report review
Remediation Patch, change configuration, compensating control, or accept the risk (documented)
Verification Rescan or retest to confirm the fix worked
Reporting Internal reports to owners and management; external reports to others

External reporting

Item Meaning
Bounty program Pays researchers who report flaws
Responsible disclosure policy Rules for reporting a flaw and giving the vendor time to fix before going public

Exam tip

. The loop is identify, prioritize, remediate, verify, report and then repeat. A false positive is a finding that is not real; a false negative is a missed real flaw. Credentialed scans find more than non-credentialed ones.

Exam tip

. The first step of security is knowing your assets: an unmanaged device is an unpatched and unmonitored device.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors retires old laptops. What must happen before they are recycled?

  • AData is sanitized and the assets are removed from inventory
  • BThey are re-imaged with the same disk
  • CThey are given to staff without a record
  • DOnly their stickers are removed
Show the answer

Answer: A. Disposal requires secure sanitization or destruction of data and updating the inventory.

S2A scan that signs in to servers with an administrator account finds more issues than an external scan. Why?

  • AIt uses a smaller database
  • BIt is a credentialed scan with deeper visibility
  • CIt ignores patches
  • DIt only checks open ports
Show the answer

Answer: B. Credentialed scans can inspect configuration and installed software that outsiders cannot see.

S3A team fixes a flaw and then runs the scanner again to prove it is gone. Which step is this?

  • APrioritization
  • BProcurement
  • CVerification
  • DDisclosure
Show the answer

Answer: C. Rescanning confirms that remediation worked.

S4A company pays outside researchers who report security flaws in its public services. What is this program?

  • ATabletop exercise
  • BChange advisory board
  • CGap analysis
  • DBounty program
Show the answer

Answer: D. A bounty program rewards responsible reports of vulnerabilities.

S5Which tool checks cloud account settings for risky configurations such as open storage?

  • AIPAM
  • BCSPM
  • CNIDS
  • DSOAR
Show the answer

Answer: B. Cloud security posture management evaluates cloud configuration against best practices.

S6A scanner reports a critical flaw that does not exist on the target. What is this finding?

  • AFalse negative
  • BFalse positive
  • CZero-day
  • DTrue positive
Show the answer

Answer: B. A reported issue that is not real is a false positive.

4.2 Recall questions

R1Name the five stages of the asset life cycle in the objectives.

Show the answer

Planning or scoping, acquisition or procurement, assignment or accounting, monitoring or tracking, and disposal or decommissioning.

R2What is the loop of vulnerability management?

Show the answer

Identify, prioritize, remediate, verify and report.

R3What does IPAM do?

Show the answer

Tracks IP address space and helps find unknown devices.

R4What is responsible disclosure?

Show the answer

Reporting a flaw privately and giving the vendor time to fix it.

R5What is a false negative?

Show the answer

A real vulnerability that the scan missed.

R6Name two remediation options.

Show the answer

Patching and a compensating control (or documented acceptance).

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Asset life cycle plan, acquire, assign (owner), monitor and track, dispose (sanitize, update inventory)
Identify scanning (credentialed deeper), IPAM, CSPM, source code review
Prioritize and fix severity, exposure, asset value, pen test reports; patch, change configuration, compensate or accept
Verify and report rescan; internal and external reports; bounty programs; responsible disclosure
